Lessons are grouped by topic and numbered in the order they build on each
other: the LTEE project you create in lesson 02 grows with every lesson after
it, and each tutorial lists what it needs at the top. When each lesson is
taught is in the schedules: [7-week course](schedule-course.qmd) and
[workshop](schedule-workshop.qmd).
